messages:
Alex: Heads-up — cutover is tomorrow 09:00 PT, can we do a quick green sweep of main CI? Looking for integration + e2e passing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4123
Mira: I'm on it, starting an e2e run now on dedicated runners, pinging @Jordan for infra quiesce
ci-bot: Started pipeline 2398765432 on main (builders: linux-x86, linux-aarch64, macos). Status: running
Jordan: macos runners are tainted with old Xcode nodes, I'll reboot one, should be back in ~10m
Sam: FYI failing tests last night were mostly `integration/payment_flow_test` and `e2e/s3_upload_spec` — I've muted payment_flow in flaky-tests list pending triage
Alex: please don't mute without owner, assigning Priya to triage `payment_flow_test` — Priya? :pray:
Priya: will triage now, suspect migration timing race introduced in commit 0f4a2d7
Priya: repro locally with `pytest tests/integration/test_payment_flow.py::test_expired_token` — seeing intermittent 504 from auth svc
Mira: looks like auth svc autoscaling caused cold starts; adding prewarm env var to runner config in this job
Jordan: spun up a dedicated auth instance on staging for the sweep — endpoint: https://staging-auth.redwood.internal
ci-bot: linux-x86 build failed: 1 failing test
Alex: which test?
ci-bot: failing: tests/integration/test_payment_flow.py::test_expired_token
Sam: switching to canary: rerunning only integration suite with `--runslow` tag
Mira: also adding KV cache warm for seeds to reduce cold path
Priya: repro steps posted in the PR comment, will attach a minimal reproducer in 15m
Alex: reminder: cutoff is 12:00 PT — if we need to block, call it by 11:30 so we can cut the release branch
Jordan: +1 — if integration still unstable at 11:00 we'll gate and bump patch version only
Sam: pinging reviewers for PR 4123: @Mira @Jordan @Alex — low risk change (config and retry), please review
Mira: reviewing now, left one nits
Alex: thx, once green I'll tag release candidate and update changelog. Suggest changelog entry: 'fix: mitigate payment flow race on auth cold start (PR #4123)'
Priya: triage conclusion: intermittent 504s due to auth cold start — adding retry/backoff fixes in PR
ci-bot: re-run 2398765432: all jobs passed ✅
Alex: awesome — going to proceed with version bump `v2.8.7` and prepare cut tomorrow
Sam: added rollout note in the release checklist, and scheduled a smoke deploy window 09:15-09:45 PT
Jordan: leaving note in #eng-sre in case infra needs to pin instances during cut
Mira: final: can we do a quick post-release sanity job targeting critical endpoints? I'll add to the release job
Alex: perfect, thanks everyone :tada:
